source: Actual native Windows Electron / production main and preload / real Vite, daemon and SQLite; @oai/sky SendInput and UIA, no CDP or route interception.
historySource: 24 explicitly synthetic v3 JSONL histories, including 132-message Chinese history; 1 real SDK + local HTTP seeded session. No real provider traffic.
limitations: Microsoft Pinyin candidate Enter committed literal ni; numeric selection committed 中 and Space selection committed 你. This is separate from synthetic composition in automatic E2E.
Native 1920×1032 maximized work area and 802×961 outer window (800px client width) were inspected; automatic Electron captures cover 1920×1080 and 800px.
New-session draft survives search / switching / settings in the current window. Existing sessionStorage contract does not retain unsent drafts across full application restart.
Future move/delete product entries are not implemented; explicit SQLite fixtures validate search projection consumption only.
Initial activation failures and user pause are historical attempts; forced fixture cleanup was not a menu exit. One occluded screenshot was discarded.
